<!-- PHI-DIRECT -->
```powershell
Write-Output '=== PHI TERMINAL UNIVERSAL 452 - ONE TERMINAL FOR EVERY GAME, FUN TO LOOK AT, STANDING BY THE LANE HAND (Ground: Tyree word whole, 2026-10-28. Make the ultimate mod terminal for any game, obviously where online allows, and make it fun looking. The Cyberpunk terminal of job 437 was one game and one door; this one is the universal form. A gold on black terminal, phi squared equals phi plus one in its header, Tab toggles it over any game at the Windows layer, and it speaks to whatever living world stands in front of it. Its commands: games lists the living game processes, attach takes the game in the foreground, status reads the attached world, godmode arms on offline seats and stands down with a smile on online seats where anti cheat lives, phi reads the rung of the attached world, help, clear, quit. The source travels base64 inside this job, decodes to PhiTerminal cs in its own folder C Users Admin PhiTerminal, compiles with the standing csc route, and the lane launches it standing in the same job, the way job 450 stood the first terminal. The earlier PhiTerminal2077 process is closed by this job first, because two hooks on one Tab would quarrel. One, close the old terminal process if it stands and print it. Two, write and decode the source, print its byte count. Three, compile to PhiTerminal exe with the framework csc and print the exe bytes. Four, launch it detached, wait three seconds, verify the process, print its pid and the tail of its universal log. The verdict in one line: UNIVERSAL TERMINAL STANDS with the pid and the exe bytes. Every variable carries the pu452 prefix.) ==='
$pu452dir = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $pu452dir | Out-Null
$pu452old = @(Get-Process -Name 'PhiTerminal2077' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
foreach ($pu452o in $pu452old) { Stop-Process -Id $pu452o.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output ('OLD TERMINAL CLOSED pid=' + $pu452o.Id) }
$pu452b64 = ''
$pu452src = Join-Path $pu452dir 'PhiTerminal.cs'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($pu452src, [Convert]::FromBase64String($pu452b64))
Write-Output ('SOURCE BYTES=' + (Get-Item $pu452src).Length)
$pu452csc = 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe'
$pu452exe = Join-Path $pu452dir 'PhiTerminal.exe'
& $pu452csc /nologo /target:winexe /out:$pu452exe /reference:System.Windows.Forms.dll /reference:System.Drawing.dll $pu452src | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('CSC ' + $_) }
$pu452exeBytes = 0; if (Test-Path $pu452exe) { $pu452exeBytes = (Get-Item $pu452exe).Length }
Write-Output ('EXE BYTES=' + $pu452exeBytes)
$pu452pid = 0; $pu452state = 'NOT-LAUNCHED'
if ($pu452exeBytes -gt 0) {
  $pu452proc = Start-Process -FilePath $pu452exe -WorkingDirectory $pu452dir -PassThru
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
  $pu452check = Get-Process -Id $pu452proc.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if ($pu452check) { $pu452state = 'STANDS'; $pu452pid = $pu452proc.Id } else { $pu452state = 'EXITED' }
}
$pu452log = Join-Path $pu452dir 'phi_terminal_universal.log'
if (Test-Path $pu452log) { Get-Content $pu452log -Tail 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('ULOG ' + $_) } } else { Write-Output 'ULOG: log absent' }
Write-Output ('PHI PU452 VERDICT: UNIVERSAL TERMINAL STANDS state=' + $pu452state + ' pid=' + $pu452pid + ' exe_bytes=' + $pu452exeBytes)
Write-Output 'JOB 452 DONE'
```
